tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default content surface: lists, sheets, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and anything that sits above the surface. In dark mode it steps lighter.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Text fields, search bars and other input wells.

tokens.name: fill-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral buttons, unselected chips and stat pills.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Wash over a row or control on hover or focus.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Wash over a row or control while pressed or selected.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, headlines and primary numbers.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, labels under numbers, captions.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Least important readable text: timestamps, units, hints. Still 4.5:1.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast, so never for information.

tokens.name: text-on-fill
tokens.usage: White text and icons on every dark fill: action-primary, control-on, danger-fill and record, in both themes.

tokens.name: text-on-bright
tokens.usage: Dark ink on every bright fill: achievement, success-fill and warning-fill, in both themes. 4.5:1 or better on each.

tokens.name: text-on-gold
tokens.usage: Alias of text-on-bright, kept so existing references resolve. Use text-on-bright.

tokens.name: icon-secondary
tokens.usage: Default icons beside text, chevrons that are the only affordance.

tokens.name: icon-muted
tokens.usage: Decorative icons that repeat a label. 3:1 like every other mark, quieter by size, not by paleness.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Kept soft on purpose: spacing and grouping already separate rows, so a divider is a hint, not a boundary. Card edges in dark take card-edge.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a raised card. Light theme raises cards with shadow-card, so this is the soft border. Dark theme has no readable shadow, so the edge carries the separation at 3:1 against surface and surface-page.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised dividers between groups. Not a track and not a control edge: tracks take track, control edges take control-boundary.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The range line of a progress bar, slider or scrubber, and the sheet handle. 3:1 on every surface, drawn 1px so the 4px control-on fill reads against it by thickness.

tokens.name: control-boundary
tokens.usage: Outline of a control whose edge identifies it: secondary button, checkbox, radio, outlined field, switch off track. 3:1.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: The one filled primary action per screen: filled buttons only. Never a mark: selected tabs, chips, indicators and progress take control-on. blue-600 in light; blue-550 in dark so the fill holds 3:1 on every dark surface, with white text-on-fill at 4.9:1.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover or press (web). Touch platforms press with their own feedback.

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Tonal fill for secondary actions and selected chips; text on it is action-link.

tokens.name: action-link
tokens.usage: Links and text buttons. Also information text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring and selected outlines.

tokens.name: control-on
tokens.usage: The on or selected state of a control and every selected mark: switch track, selected chip, selected segment, tab indicator, progress fill. 3:1 on every surface; white text-on-fill on it holds 4.9:1 or better.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: The brand ground: the app icon, splash and store art, as a gradient from blue-600 to blue-700 under the gold mark (2.9 to 3.8:1). Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: achievement
tokens.usage: Gold fill and gold marks for PRs, records, trophies and celebrations only: the record ring and staircase in charts. 3:1 on every surface. Text on it is text-on-bright.

tokens.name: achievement-text
tokens.usage: Gold text and icons: a PR time, a trophy glyph.

tokens.name: achievement-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind an achievement badge; its text is achievement-on-bg.

tokens.name: achievement-on-bg
tokens.usage: Text on achievement-bg.

tokens.name: section-badge
tokens.usage: A numbered section badge in a list or card, the same badge the map draws. Its number is section-badge-ink.

tokens.name: section-badge-ink
tokens.usage: The number on section-badge: 8.0:1 light, 7.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: compass-north
tokens.usage: The north half of the compass needle. Red by convention; 3:1 on the map control ground in both themes.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Positive status: text, icons and marks (dots, borders, map start pins). Always with a word or icon. 4.5:1 as text.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a positive status chip or banner.

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Solid positive fill with a label: a positive badge, the restore swipe action. Text on it is text-on-bright (4.9:1 light, 7.8:1 dark). 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning status: text, icons and marks. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a warning chip or banner.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Solid warning fill with a label: the hide swipe action, a caution badge. Text on it is text-on-bright. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Error and destructive status: text, icons and marks (error dots, removed-section lines). Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind an error chip or banner.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Filled destructive button and the delete swipe action. Text on it is text-on-fill (6.5:1 light, 4.9:1 dark). 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Recording: the record button, the live recording dot, the recording widget, Live Activity accent and recording notification. Its own role, never action-primary. Text and glyph on it are text-on-fill (6.2:1 light, 4.9:1 dark). 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind an information banner. Its title is text-primary and its icon action-link.

tokens.name: chart-series
tokens.usage: The default colour of a single-series chart: trends, sparklines, histograms, wellness rows. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised series beside the one that matters: past laps, unmarked weeks, context dots. 3:1, quieter by size (6px dots, 1px lines).

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines: 3:1 like every mark, kept quiet by being 1px dotted (1 on, 3 off), never by paleness.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: The baseline and zero line of a chart: 1px solid, one step stronger than the dotted grid.

tokens.name: chart-reference
tokens.usage: Threshold lines (FTP, critical speed, record): dashed, labelled at their end, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: chart-crosshair
tokens.usage: The scrub line that follows a finger across a chart.

tokens.name: direction-forward
tokens.usage: A section ridden or run in its forward direction. Kept off focus-ring and action-primary so a forward dot never reads as selected.

tokens.name: direction-reverse
tokens.usage: The reverse direction: rust against forward blue, warm against cool so the pair survives colour blindness.

tokens.name: stream-power
tokens.usage: Power line and its lane. Amber, kept clear of the achievement gold. Validated as a set in chip order power, heart rate, cadence, speed, GAP, W'bal: neighbours at least 12.0 apart under colour-blind simulation, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: stream-heartrate
tokens.usage: Heart rate. Crimson by convention; darker than error-text in light and pinker in dark so the two never read as one. Validated as a set in chip order power, heart rate, cadence, speed, GAP, W'bal: neighbours at least 12.0 apart under colour-blind simulation, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: stream-cadence
tokens.usage: Cadence. Validated as a set in chip order power, heart rate, cadence, speed, GAP, W'bal: neighbours at least 12.0 apart under colour-blind simulation, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: stream-speed
tokens.usage: Speed or pace: one measurement, one colour. Show pace for runs and swims, speed for rides; never both. Validated as a set in chip order power, heart rate, cadence, speed, GAP, W'bal: neighbours at least 12.0 apart under colour-blind simulation, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: stream-gap
tokens.usage: Grade-adjusted pace, drawn in the pace lane beside pace. Validated as a set in chip order power, heart rate, cadence, speed, GAP, W'bal: neighbours at least 12.0 apart under colour-blind simulation, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: stream-wbal
tokens.usage: W'bal, the anaerobic battery. Validated as a set in chip order power, heart rate, cadence, speed, GAP, W'bal: neighbours at least 12.0 apart under colour-blind simulation, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: stream-context

tokens.name: stream-context-line

styles.name: screenTitle
styles.usage: Screen titles.

styles.name: sectionTitle
styles.usage: Section titles within a screen.

styles.name: cardTitle
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text.

styles.name: bodyBold
styles.usage: Emphasised body text and button labels.

styles.name: bodyMedium
styles.usage: Row titles and list text.

styles.name: bodySmall
styles.usage: Secondary text, small buttons.

styles.name: bodySmallBold
styles.usage: 14px text that must stand out: a small button label, a banner title, a key value in a row. Folds the 14px 500 and 600 sites.

styles.name: bodyCompact
styles.usage: Dense rows and chip labels.

styles.name: bodyCompactBold
styles.usage: 13px text that must stand out: a chip label, a pill title. Folds the 13px 500 and 600 sites.

styles.name: heroNumber
styles.usage: The one headline number on a screen. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: statsHero
styles.usage: Recording screen timer. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: largeNumber
styles.usage: Large stat values. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: headlineNumber
styles.usage: Headline values in a card. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: statsValueLarge
styles.usage: Stat values in a hero row. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: statsValue
styles.usage: Stat values in a grid. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: metricValue
styles.usage: Metric values beside labels. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: tableValue
styles.usage: Cells in a table of numbers. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: pillValue
styles.usage: Values inside stat pills.

styles.name: statsLabel
styles.usage: Label under a stat value: supporting text, so 400. Set uppercase (text-transform), keeping the string as translated.

styles.name: sectionHeader
styles.usage: Header above a group of rows. 600 because it names the group. Set uppercase (text-transform), keeping the string as translated.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, timestamps, units.

styles.name: captionBold
styles.usage: A caption that must stand out: a delta, a status word, a record time. State the reason when you use it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small labels on controls. 600 because an 11px uppercase label must hold at its size on a control. Set uppercase (text-transform), keeping the string as translated.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Smallest text, one or two words: legend ticks, small units. 400; nothing at this size may need emphasis.

styles.name: pillLabel
styles.usage: Label inside a stat pill. Below 10px; keep to one or two words. Set uppercase (text-transform), keeping the string as translated.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and formulas only.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: a badge from its label, chart axis padding.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip; vertical padding of a chip.

tokens.name: space-xs-plus
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside compact controls and tooltips.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Default gap between related items; card-to-card margin.

tokens.name: space-sm-plus
tokens.usage: Row padding and the gap between a control and its text.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Screen edge padding and card padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Around hero numbers and empty states.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Large breaks: above an empty state, below a hero.

tokens.name: screen-padding
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of every screen (space-md).

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a card (space-md).

tokens.name: card-margin
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards (space-sm).

radius.note: From src/theme/spacing.ts layout. The source names radius-lg 24 and radius-xl 20, so xl is smaller than lg; kept as written.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Dots, progress bars, tiny marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chips, small cards, inline controls, buttons.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards: the default container radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and large pills. Note: smaller than radius-lg, as named in the source.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large pills and rounded containers.

tokens.name: radius-xxl
tokens.usage: Top corners of an Android bottom sheet (Material extra-large).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles and full pills: avatars, the record button, switches.

size.note: Control heights from src/theme/spacing.ts. Controls are drawn at their height and reach the tap target through hit slop.

tokens.name: control-chip
tokens.usage: Selector chip height: an 18px bodyCompact line with 4px above and below.

tokens.name: control-button-sm
tokens.usage: Small button height.

tokens.name: control-button
tokens.usage: Button height, and the square an icon-only button is drawn in.

tokens.name: tap-target-ios
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on iOS (Human Interface Guidelines).

tokens.name: tap-target-android
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on Android (Material).

tokens.name: record-fab
tokens.usage: Diameter of the floating record button.

tokens.name: screen-min-width
tokens.usage: The narrowest Android screen every layout must hold at, at default text size and at 1.3x.

tokens.name: screen-min-width-ios
tokens.usage: The narrowest iPhone width every layout must hold at.

shadow.note: From src/theme/shadows.ts. These are the web values. Each platform draws its own: Android sets only elevation, iOS uses its own offset, opacity and radius (foundations.md, Elevation). In dark mode, anything that floats keeps its shadow and adds a 1px card-edge. Glows are retired.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and badges over a map or image (elevation 1).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and containers, and buttons that float (elevation 2).

tokens.name: shadow-map-overlay
tokens.usage: Controls floating over the map (elevation 3).

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Floating elements: menus, popovers (elevation 4).

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: The record button (elevation 6).

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and overlays (elevation 8).

tokens.name: shadow-handle
tokens.usage: Small draggable handles and slider thumbs.

opacity.note: The alpha ladder. Every translucent tint, wash, dim and press uses one of these steps; no other alpha values.

tokens.name: opacity-tint-1
tokens.usage: Faint wash: a selected row, an area under a line in light theme.

tokens.name: opacity-tint-2
tokens.usage: Tint behind a chip, icon tile or badge in light theme; area wash in dark theme. Its text is the hue's -text token or text-primary, checked at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: opacity-tint-3
tokens.usage: Tint behind a chip, icon tile or badge in dark theme; zone and interval bands.

tokens.name: opacity-tint-4
tokens.usage: Strong band: the selected zone or interval band, a focused range.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Out of play but still in the layout: a hidden legend series, an unfocused chip.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control, whole control at once, and its state is exposed to assistive technology.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: iOS press fade. Android uses the platform ripple instead.

icon.note: The icon size ladder. Every glyph takes one of these six sizes; an icon beside text matches the text it sits with.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Inside badges and 11px labels; dense meta rows.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Beside caption or bodyCompact text: banners, chips, pills, small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Beside body or bodySmall text: rows, chevrons, medium buttons, menus.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Toolbars, headers, the tab bar, setting-row leading icons, sheet close.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Compact empty states and the glyph on a 56px record button.

tokens.name: icon-xxl
tokens.usage: Full-screen empty and error states.

stroke.note: Border and line widths. No other values.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers: the platform hairline (StyleSheet.hairlineWidth in React Native).

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Card edges, control edges, chart gridlines and axes, map line edges.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Chart lines, focus rings, selected rings, a focused text field edge, dot rings.

tokens.name: stroke-3
tokens.usage: The tab indicator and the selected ring on a picture option.

layer.note: The layer scale. Every zIndex takes one of these; floating pieces never share a layer.

tokens.name: layer-base
tokens.usage: Content.

tokens.name: layer-raised
tokens.usage: Something lifted within its own container: a selected bar, a dragged row.

tokens.name: layer-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and tab strips inside a scroll view.

tokens.name: layer-map-overlay
tokens.usage: Map controls, keys, the attribution pill and map popups.

tokens.name: layer-floating
tokens.usage: Floating pills and the record button. Pills stack; they never overlap.

tokens.name: layer-tab-bar
tokens.usage: The bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: layer-banner
tokens.usage: The top banner slot.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: Snackbars.

tokens.name: layer-overlay
tokens.usage: Full overlays the app draws itself, such as the body loupe or the section creation overlay. Platform sheets, menus and alerts sit above all of these.

duration.note: Motion durations. With reduce motion on, moves become a fade at duration-quick or none, loops stop, and map camera moves jump.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Appear: a popup, the loupe, a pressed state.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Small exits and fades: a pill leaving, a tooltip, the reduce-motion replacement for a move.

tokens.name: duration-exit
tokens.usage: Exits of anything that entered at duration-standard. Exits are never longer than entries.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Moves on screen: the pager, a disclosure opening, a banner sliding in, layout changes.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Cross-fades of whole areas: the splash into the first screen, switching 2D and 3D, a card entering.

tokens.name: duration-message
tokens.usage: A status line changing its words (the sync pill).

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: One half of a pulse: a skeleton, a live status dot. At most three cycles unless it shows progress.

tokens.name: duration-hold
tokens.usage: How long a status message holds before the next may replace it.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: One turn of a progress mark (the sync ring). Static under reduce motion.
